tools.name: flights_get-aircraft-trajectory
tools.description: Full trajectory for one aircraft within a time window. Required: icao24. Optional: begin, end. Returns array of FlightsGetAircraftTrajectoryItem.

params.name: begin
params.description: Window start, Unix seconds (defaults to now-2h)

params.name: end
params.description: Window end, Unix seconds (defaults to now)

tools.name: flights_get-departures
tools.description: Flights departing an airport within a time window. Required: airport. Optional: begin, end. Returns array of FlightsGetDeparturesItem.

params.name: begin
params.description: Window start, Unix seconds (defaults to now-2h)

params.name: end
params.description: Window end, Unix seconds (defaults to now)

tools.name: states_list
tools.description: Live aircraft states over a bounding box or for one transponder. Optional: lamin, lomin, lamax (plus 2 more). Returns array of StatesListItem.

params.name: lamin
params.description: Minimum latitude of the bounding box (degrees)

params.name: lomin
params.description: Minimum longitude of the bounding box (degrees)

params.name: lamax
params.description: Maximum latitude of the bounding box (degrees)

params.name: lomax
params.description: Maximum longitude of the bounding box (degrees)

params.name: icao24
params.description: 6-hex-digit transponder address to filter to a single aircraft
